locked.text: With Premium, Vera writes a summary of these numbers here in 3 or 4 sentences.

consent.notice: To write this summary, Vera sends aggregated totals to a language model, through a Vercel service. Names of people and merchants, transaction descriptions, accounts and credentials are never sent. The model provider uses what it receives and what it writes to train its own models, with no zero retention.
consent.noticeSelfHosted: To write this summary, Vera sends aggregated totals to the language model you registered in Integrations. Names of people and merchants, transaction descriptions, accounts and credentials are never sent.
consent.hint: You can turn it off in Settings › Data and privacy.
consent.askEditor: Ask an Owner or Editor to allow it.

privacy.title: Text summaries
privacy.description: The texts for the month, the cuts and the portfolio are written by a language model, from aggregated totals sent through a Vercel service. Names of people and merchants, transaction descriptions, accounts and credentials are never sent. The model provider uses what it receives and what it writes to train its own models, with no zero retention. When it is off, nothing more is sent.
privacy.descriptionSelfHosted: The texts for the month, the cuts and the portfolio are written by the language model you registered in Integrations, from aggregated totals. Names of people and merchants, transaction descriptions, accounts and credentials are never sent. When it is off, nothing more is sent.
privacy.switchHint: When off, nothing is sent and the summaries disappear from the screens.
privacy.switchScope: Applies to the summaries and to the questions in the app and on WhatsApp.
privacy.askEditor: Ask an Owner or Editor to change this.
privacy.loadFailed: Could not read the permission right now.
privacy.revoked: Summaries turned off. Nothing more is sent
privacy.confirmDescription: Nothing more is sent and the stored texts are deleted.

errors.consentRequired: Allow sending the totals to see this summary.
errors.capReached: Summaries paused until {{date}}. The monthly quota is used up; the rest of Vera keeps working.
errors.capReachedNoDate: Summaries paused until the month turns. The monthly quota is used up; the rest of Vera keeps working.
errors.unavailable: Could not write the summary right now. The numbers on the screen are still right.
errors.noticeOutdated: The notice changed. Read the request again and allow it once more.
errors.repeated: This summary was already written several times today from the same numbers. It changes when the numbers change.
errors.tooMany: You asked for too many summaries this hour. Try again later.
errors.notConfigured: This server does not have the language model registered yet.
errors.generic: Could not show the summary right now. Try again in a moment.
